protocol.rationale: The original screen retains its predeclared <=25% edge-work growth gate and all results. The user goal is road solve time; independently test the fastest training-only queue even though it exceeds that work gate. Do not promote it for distributed runs.
protocol.queue_choice: Fastest geometric mean among candidates improving both training-source medians >=5% and beating both original/control geometric means >=5%, ignoring work growth for this explicitly time-focused follow-up. No held-out data used.
protocol.layout_choice: For that frozen queue only, test 16x7,8x14,8x7: previous best, runner-up at 112 workers, and best reduced-core choice (56). Each training source: warmup+3 randomized repetitions. Change from16x7 only if >=5% faster on both training sources. Otherwise retain16x7.
protocol.heldout: Base heap16x7, new queue16x7, queue at selected layout, duplicate base, Wasp; four test sources, warmup+3 randomized repeats. Retain all repetitions. Every solve independently validated; actual affinity checked.
protocol.work: Original, queue16x7 and combined cost builds on first two test sources. Conservation and publication accounting; instrumented timing separate.
protocol.acceptance: Report solve time jointly with additional edge work, rounds, occupancy and publication behavior. A time improvement does not make this a work-efficient or distributed default. No further tuning on these test sources.
protocol.prediction: Band65536 full-only chunks showed training speedup1.217-1.293 with1.704-1.811x edge work. Confirm >=1.10x held-out speedup beyond control noise; partial requests were slower than full-only at this band and are not selected.
protocol.scope: Separate sequential allocation on one exclusive Delta cpu-interactive node; +old-scheduler; no additional rebuild.

notes: Charm++ current tracking branch was already up to date; no branch switch was assumed.
Reconverse local LCI pin was preserved.
Reconverse main now defaults backend_poll_freq to 64; the prior runtime default was 4.
Previous campaign runtime and application binaries remain intact.

validation.scope: Local-only runtime checks; distributed shared-memory communication has not been rerun on compute nodes in this refresh.
